title: A Cluster-Randomized Clinical Trial of Silver Diamine Fluoride vs Atraumatic Restoration in Older Adults
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Volume 105, Issue 12, Page 1527-1535, November 2026.
Untreated dental caries, a chronic disease linked to systemic health, is common among older adults due to a lack of dental insurance and affordable dental care. Minimally invasive interventions such as silver diamine fluoride (SDF) and atraumatic ...
